method: Read the evidence pack only: digest.md, desktop-fold.png, mobile-fold.png, sheet-desktop.png, sheet-mobile.png, motion-sheet.png, fit.json, plus brief.md, strategy.md (profile, Q1-Q6, idea sentence) and copycheck.json. Not verified: whether tapping a weekday actually changes the box fillings (no screenshot shows a second state), keyboard focus styles, tab/accordion ARIA, alt text on the drawings, colour contrast by measurement (judged by eye), hover states, motion on a real GPU (digest says software rendering). Did not open critic.md or taste.md.

reasons.clarity: Both folds answer Q1 at once: 107px headline 'Makan siang seimbang ke kantormu.', one line naming area, days and the four parts, Rp 45.000 with 'langganan mulai 5 hari', one WhatsApp button (desktop-fold, mobile-fold). Sections follow Q2-Q7 in order, each with a plain heading (sheet-desktop); copycheck 0 warnings, average sentence 6.6 words. Mobile keeps the Chat button in the sticky header. Docked from 9 because the four-part rule, the page's main claim, is not readable in the hero drawing (see problem 2).
reasons.distinctiveness: The flat drawn bento box in maroon/yellow/green/pink is ownable and recurs as logo mark, hero, the 'empat bagian' diagram, the week section and five mini boxes as the 5-day price unit (desktop-page-04, mobile-page-05). That is better than a stock catering page. But the strategy's idea (fixed compartments, filling changes per tapped weekday) does not show in the evidence: the week box is identical to the hero box, mobile drops the box beside the week list, and motion is a generic fade-up. From desktop-page-04 down the page is off-white/white sections with hairline rules that any SaaS template produces; fit.json misses the bold-colour dial.
reasons.craft: Good: Bricolage/Figtree pairing with a 6.7x scale, consistent 999px buttons with a solid drop edge, CLS 0.005, 60 fps with 0 long frames, one easing cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) at 320 ms on opacity/transform only, nothing moves by itself, reduced motion honoured, honest footer note 'ilustrasi, bukan foto menu'. Loose: ~150px dead band under the hero CTA (desktop-fold); price section has tiny mini boxes with a ~10px-looking caption and a CTA stranded low in the right column (desktop-page-04); the 'Kirim pesan ini' button floats outside the message preview with a big empty right half (desktop-page-05); rice drawing is pink flecks on a maroon slab that reads as texture at small sizes.

problems: The signature module does not demonstrate itself: in desktop-page-03 and motion-sheet 07-scroll-2250px the box beside the Senin-Jumat list shows the same ayam/sayur/semangka as the hero, and on mobile (mobile-page-03, mobile-page-04) the week is a plain stack of five list cards with no box at all, so 'bagiannya tetap, isinya ganti' is told in text, not shown. Fix: the box fillings must visibly change per weekday (redraw lauk/sayur/buah per day), keep the box sticky next to the list on mobile, and let the scroll/tap motion be that swap instead of generic fade-ups (motion-sheet 05-scroll-450px).

Hero drawing hides the claim it carries: in desktop-fold the box bleeds off the right edge and the rice compartment takes about half the box, so lauk, sayur and buah are three cropped slivers and the first impression is a maroon slab; in mobile-fold only rice and ayam show below the CTA. Fix: rotate/scale so all four compartments are fully inside the frame on desktop, give rice a smaller share, and on mobile show the whole box (smaller) rather than a cropped corner; use the ~150px empty band under the CTA in desktop-fold.

The bold flat-colour system stops after the box sections: price, steps and FAQ (desktop-page-04, -05, -06; mobile-page-05 to -07) are off-white/white with hairline rules, small grey captions and loosely placed CTAs (price CTA low in the right column, send button floating beside the message preview). Carry the compartment colours into these sections as roles (e.g. the four steps/items keyed to the four compartment colours, the message preview as a filled box) and tighten alignment so each CTA sits under its content.
keep: Hero hierarchy (headline, one-line offer, price, single CTA all in the first screen on desktop and mobile): answers what/where/how much before any scroll.
Drawn four-compartment box as the one recurring motif, including the logo mark: gives a kitchen with no photos and no logo an ownable picture without faking food photography.
Five mini boxes = 'Senin sampai Jumat: lima kotak' next to Rp 225.000: makes the 5-day minimum concrete and turns the price into units of the product.
Pre-filled WhatsApp message preview with the four fields: removes the 'ribet pesannya' fear right before the action.
Motion restraint: single easing, 320 ms, transform/opacity only, no autoplay or loops, reduced motion honoured, 60 fps: safe for mid-range phones on office Wi-Fi and for vestibular-sensitive users.
Sticky header with a compact Chat button on mobile: the action is one thumb away throughout the page.
Footer disclosure 'Gambar di halaman ini ilustrasi, bukan foto menu': honest given the brief's no-stock-food rule.
